requirements.requirement: Every /plans document is represented in the requirement ledger.
requirements.notes: All planning Markdown files are enumerated into index-only traceability records.

requirements.requirement: Every v1 requirement has a reviewed machine-readable status.
requirements.notes: Machine-readable statuses are supplied by the core registry plus the evidence override registry.

requirements.requirement: No requirement is marked implemented without evidence.
requirements.notes: The generator rejects verified rows without implementation files, checks, and evidence.

requirements.requirement: The project is a real Git repository.
requirements.notes: The workspace is a real Git worktree.

requirements.requirement: The Forgejo remote exists and contains the project.
requirements.blocker: Requires the approved Forgejo repository and push operation to be completed through Tower.

requirements.requirement: CI runs on Forgejo Actions.
externalDependencies: Forgejo Actions runner and workflow execution
requirements.blocker: Workflow definitions are present and CI is wired, but a hosted Forgejo Actions run has not yet produced a receipt.
requirements.notes: Local workflow configuration is not the same as a completed hosted CI run.

requirements.requirement: Generated files no longer cause author-source lint failures.
requirements.notes: Generated evidence and ledgers are excluded or represented by explicit generated-file boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Repository-wide formatting passes.
requirements.notes: Repository formatting passes with volatile reports excluded from the source formatting gate.

requirements.requirement: Lint passes.
requirements.notes: Workspace lint passes locally.

requirements.requirement: Typecheck passes.
requirements.notes: Workspace typecheck has passed during this remediation pass.

requirements.requirement: Unit tests pass.
requirements.notes: Focused tests have passed; the full current-candidate suite remains a final gate.

requirements.requirement: Production build passes.
requirements.notes: The current production web build has passed locally.

requirements.requirement: Browser smoke tests pass.
requirements.notes: Development smoke and standalone production-browser checks are implemented; full verify must refresh the evidence.

requirements.requirement: Documentation tests pass.
requirements.notes: Documentation ingestion, validation, normalized routing, and focused tests are implemented.

requirements.requirement: Internal link and route tests pass.
requirements.notes: Route and internal-link checks are part of the RC verification sequence.

requirements.requirement: SEO, sitemap, and feed behavior is validated.
requirements.notes: Sitemap, canonical/discovery, feed, and publication-clock checks pass locally; hosted feed acceptance remains external.

requirements.requirement: Hosted search success and static fallback tests pass.
requirements.notes: The primary provider timeout/error path returns the static public fallback and marks degraded mode; live Typesense remains external.

requirements.requirement: Kit implementation tests pass even when external credentials are absent.
requirements.notes: Disabled, validation, origin, bounded-body, idempotency, rate-limit, and provider-failure paths pass without provider credentials.

requirements.requirement: Rich search UI browser tests pass.
requirements.notes: The production search overlay and query interaction are exercised locally; hosted provider results remain external.

requirements.requirement: Fumadocs rendering is used consistently for supported documentation surfaces.
requirements.notes: Central reviewed documents use the Fumadocs adapter and the normalized route contract; non-central sources retain the safe alternate renderer by design.

requirements.requirement: Project maturity and health are separate and properly modeled.
requirements.notes: Project status and maturity metadata are represented, but public factual approval of project health/maturity is still pending.

requirements.requirement: Planned project, governance, and publication models are implemented.
requirements.notes: Models and publication-state filtering are implemented; final governance/editorial approval is external.

requirements.requirement: Planned global utilities are implemented.
requirements.blocker: Search, theme, mobile navigation, newsletter, error, health, and discovery utilities are implemented and tested, but the desktop GitHub action, approved contribution destination, and complete mobile legal-link utility set cannot be finalized without owner-approved public destinations and copy.
requirements.notes: Partial is intentional: the current shell exposes only destinations that are locally defined and approved; no public GitHub or contribution URL is invented.

requirements.requirement: Mobile navigation and interaction states are tested.
requirements.notes: Mobile navigation opening/closing and compact-header interaction pass against the production artifact.

requirements.requirement: Automated visual regression is comprehensive and green against the current candidate baseline/reference policy.
requirements.blocker: Thirteen clean production captures exist, but reference comparison, intentional-deviation approval, and rights approval require accountable human reviewers.
requirements.notes: The visual tool never converts a screenshot hash into an automatic approval.

requirements.requirement: Accessibility automation covers representative templates and interaction flows.
requirements.notes: Representative production routes and interaction states pass the RC accessibility suite; this is not a complete human audit.

requirements.requirement: Lighthouse CI actually runs and passes configured thresholds.
externalDependencies: Usable local or hosted Chromium runner for a fresh Lighthouse execution
requirements.blocker: The Lighthouse implementation and configured budgets are present, but the current local manifest is stale/running and the performance gate cannot accept it; a fresh bounded Lighthouse run is required.

requirements.requirement: Production CSP and header behavior is tested against the real build.
requirements.notes: Nonce-based production CSP, hydration, headers, and representative interactivity pass against the standalone build.

requirements.requirement: Container build passes.
externalDependencies: Docker daemon or hosted Linux container runner
requirements.blocker: The image and runtime check are implemented, but the current Windows environment timed out during docker version before producing a runtime receipt.

requirements.requirement: Container starts as a non-root user.
externalDependencies: Docker daemon or hosted Linux container runner
requirements.blocker: The non-root assertion is implemented but has no current local runtime receipt because the Docker daemon is unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Container health test passes.
externalDependencies: Docker daemon or hosted Linux container runner
requirements.blocker: Standalone production health evidence exists, but the container health path cannot be revalidated locally until a Docker-capable runner is available.

requirements.requirement: An SBOM is generated.
requirements.notes: CycloneDX and SPDX lockfile SBOMs are generated locally; final hosted image SBOM and signing remain external.

requirements.requirement: Vulnerability scanning runs with an explicit severity policy.
requirements.notes: Production dependencies pass the high-severity policy; development-tool advisory groups remain recorded with a disposition requirement.

requirements.requirement: Secret scanning runs.
requirements.notes: Local secret-pattern scan passes; provider secret values are not stored in the repository.

requirements.requirement: Release identity is tied to the exact Forgejo commit and immutable artifact digest.
requirements.blocker: Local source and image identity are recorded, but the exact RC tag, signed provenance, hosted immutable digest, and deployed-digest equality are not yet available.

requirements.requirement: Tower staging deployment succeeds.
requirements.blocker: Capability is available, but a project-scoped staging workload and approved repository deployment must still be created and verified.

requirements.requirement: Staging health and smoke checks pass.
requirements.blocker: Depends on the staging workload and URL created by the authorized deployment gate.

requirements.requirement: Tower Typesense works.
externalDependencies: Tower Typesense resource and scoped credentials
requirements.blocker: The adapter and outage contract can be verified locally; live success requires staging resource binding and credentials.

requirements.requirement: Typesense outage automatically falls back to static search.
requirements.notes: A simulated primary-provider outage returns static public search results with degraded=true; hosted outage telemetry remains external.

requirements.requirement: Valkey-backed distributed protections work where implemented.
externalDependencies: Tower Valkey endpoint and secret binding
requirements.blocker: The adapter and fail-closed behavior are locally tested, but distributed rate/idempotency behavior needs the authorized staging Valkey service.

requirements.requirement: A GlitchTip staging event is captured and verified.
externalDependencies: GlitchTip project, DSN secret binding, event authority
requirements.blocker: No observability provider has been activated or sent a labeled staging event.

requirements.requirement: Synthetic monitoring is configured and evidenced.
requirements.blocker: Monitor definitions exist, but no hosted staging endpoints or monitor IDs have been returned.

requirements.requirement: A staging rollback drill succeeds.
requirements.blocker: The rollback procedure validates locally, but an A-to-B-to-A hosted staging drill has not been authorized or run.

requirements.requirement: A complete release evidence bundle exists.
requirements.notes: The bundle generator records current checks, identity, hashes, and explicit owner blockers; hosted receipts are added only when present.

requirements.requirement: A release-candidate tag and artifact exist.
verificationCommands: pending authorized v1.0.0-rc.1 tag and artifact receipt
requirements.blocker: The branch is pushed privately, but the RC tag and hosted immutable artifact are deliberately deferred until the final source commit and release review.

requirements.requirement: The repository remains free of secrets.
requirements.notes: No high-confidence credential pattern was found locally; actual provider values remain outside the repository.

requirements.requirement: External and manual blockers are reduced to a concise honest next-phase list.
requirements.notes: Owner-only approvals, credentials, domains, production authority, and publication decisions have explicit handoff steps.

requirements.requirement: Authentication, API, and platform integration work has not been started.
requirements.notes: Authentication, API, and platform integrations remain outside the authorized v1 closure scope.

requirements.requirement: Every GitHub and Forgejo workflow uses immutable action references, least-privilege top-level permissions, concurrency, bounded jobs, disabled checkout credential persistence, and no unsafe trigger or browser-shell settings.
requirements.notes: The policy is checked locally; hosted execution, branch protection, and administrator settings remain separate evidence.

requirements.requirement: Each private workspace package can be packed, installed into a clean external temporary consumer, typechecked, and runtime-imported without workspace resolution.
requirements.notes: The packages are private source-package contracts; this does not claim independently published compiled distributions.

requirements.requirement: Repeated generated search output is byte-identical under fixed locale, timezone, publication-clock, and CI controls.
requirements.notes: The check compares bytes and fails on differences rather than normalizing nondeterministic output away.

requirements.requirement: Launch evidence accepts generated checks only when the recorded source identity and clean source state match the current revision or an explicitly generated-evidence-only descendant.
requirements.notes: Historical reports remain visible but cannot satisfy current launch checks without matching identity evidence.

requirements.requirement: Production web build wrappers preserve authored Next.js generated type stubs and do not leave incidental build mutations in the source tree.
requirements.notes: The wrappers restore next-env.d.ts after both successful and failed builds.

requirements.requirement: First-party pnpm child processes use explicit shell-free arguments with safe Windows pnpm.cmd handling, avoiding Node shell-array deprecation behavior.
requirements.notes: DEP0169 was not reproduced from first-party or installed dependency paths; the first-party DEP0190 shell-array pattern was removed.

requirements.requirement: The repository runs an executable license and notice policy check for code, documentation, trademarks, and private package metadata without treating that check as legal approval.
requirements.notes: Automated policy consistency is covered locally; third-party license review and qualified legal approval remain external gates.
